```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# import the ex vivo object and re-clustered monocytes with pseudotime trajectoruies calculated
```{r import exvvio seurat object susbset B cells and recluster, include=TRUE, message=TRUE}
# import the ffll ex vivo 78k object
temp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1W_oqvtGPdUlF2BcOH4AKsc80ZS2DNPCy"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
exvivo<-readRDS(file = dl$local_path)
```

# a. plot umapsof all 78k cells separated by subject
```{r per subject umap, fig.align='center', fig.width= 12, fig.height= 4}

Idents(exvivo)<-exvivo$phenotype
aparacells<-WhichCells(exvivo, idents = "Aparasitemic")
paracells<-WhichCells(exvivo, idents = "Parasitemic")


apara_umap <- DimPlot(exvivo,  pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "ref.umap", cells = aparacells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") 

para_umap <- DimPlot(exvivo,  pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "ref.umap",  cells = paracells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") 

all_umap <- bind_rows(apara_umap,
                          para_umap) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic")))

library(ggh4x)
strip_apara <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#58a4cb", alpha = 0.6)))

strip_para <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#e41a1c", alpha = 0.6)))



all_umap <- all_umap %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode")

all_umap_plot_bysubj_apara <- exvivo@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode", "predicted.celltype.l1")) %>%
  left_join(all_umap, by="barcode") %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0585", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0618", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0631", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0647", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0593", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0600", "subject 9", subj_id)) %>%
    mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 10", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 11", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 12", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 13", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0651", "subject 14", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "aparasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, fill = "predicted.celltype.l1")) +
  geom_point(pch=21, size = 1, stroke = 0.05) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(factor(subj_id)), strip = strip_apara, independent = "all", scales = "free", space= "free")

all_umap_plot_bysubj_para <- exvivo@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode", "predicted.celltype.l1")) %>%
  left_join(all_umap, by="barcode") %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0585", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0618", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0631", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0647", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0593", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0600", "subject 9", subj_id)) %>%
    mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 10", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 11", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 12", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 13", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0651", "subject 14", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "parasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, fill = "predicted.celltype.l1")) +
  geom_point(pch=21, size = 1, stroke = 0.05) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(factor(subj_id, levels = c("subject 8", "subject 9", "subject 10", "subject 11", "subject 12", "subject 13", "subject 14"))), strip = strip_para, independent = "all", scales = "free", space= "free")

all_umap_by_subj <- plot_grid(all_umap_plot_bysubj_apara,
                              all_umap_plot_bysubj_para,
                              nrow = 2)
```

# b. Import wnn re-clustered nk and monocytes from figure 5 and show per subject distribution

```{r nkmono wnn umap plots, fig.align='center', fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
temp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1rgn3_aGYcAI-MNjhR-tftAbtNJ6FJRiT"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
nkmono <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)


# downsample

table(nkmono$phenotype)

Idents(nkmono) <- 'phenotype'
cell.list.para <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Parasitemic", downsample = 1503)
cell.list.apara <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Aparasitemic")

cell.list <- c(cell.list.apara, cell.list.para)

nkmono.downsampled <- nkmono[, cell.list]

Idents(nkmono.downsampled) <- 'seurat_clusters'


DimPlot(nkmono.downsampled, reduction = "wnn.umap", label=T, split.by = "phenotype")

apara_wnn_dat <- DimPlot(nkmono.downsampled, 
                              group.by = "ident",  
                              pt.size = 0.5, 
                              reduction = "wnn.umap", 
                              cells = cell.list.apara, 
                              alpha = 0.45, 
                              combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") 

para_wnn_dat <- DimPlot(nkmono.downsampled, 
                             group.by = "ident", 
                             pt.size = 0.5, 
                             reduction = "wnn.umap", 
                             cells = cell.list.para, 
                             alpha = 0.45, 
                             combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") 

all_wnn_dat <- bind_rows(apara_wnn_dat,
                          para_wnn_dat) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic"))) %>%
  mutate(ident = case_when(
    ident == "13" ~ "14",
    ident == "12" ~ "13",
     ident == "11" ~ "12",
     ident == "10" ~ "11",
    ident == "9" ~ "10",
    ident == "8" ~ "9",
    ident == "7" ~ "8",
    ident == "6" ~ "7",
    ident == "5" ~ "6",
    ident == "4" ~ "5",
    ident == "3" ~ "4",
    ident == "2" ~ "3",
    ident == "1" ~ "2",
    ident == "0" ~ "1"))

library(ggh4x)
strip_apara <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#58a4cb", alpha = 0.6)))

strip_para <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#e41a1c", alpha = 0.6)))


new_colors = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(10,"Spectral"))(length(unique(all_wnn_dat$ident)))

all_wnn_dat <- all_wnn_dat %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode")

all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_apara <- nkmono.downsampled@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode")) %>%
  left_join(all_wnn_dat, by="barcode") %>%
   mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0618", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "aparasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = wnnUMAP_1, y = wnnUMAP_2, color = factor(ident,levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ident))))))) +
  geom_point(pch=21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
 scale_color_manual(values = new_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,1,0.1,1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(subj_id), strip = strip_apara)

all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_para <- nkmono.downsampled@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode")) %>%
  left_join(all_wnn_dat, by="barcode") %>%
   mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0618", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "parasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = wnnUMAP_1, y = wnnUMAP_2, color = factor(ident,levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ident))))))) +
  geom_point(pch=21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
 scale_color_manual(values = new_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,1,0.1,1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(subj_id), strip = strip_para) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cluster",
                                 nrow = 3,
                                 override.aes = list(size=2.5)))

all_wnn_umap_by_subj <- plot_grid(all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_apara,
                              all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_para,
                              nrow = 2,
                              rel_heights = c(0.8,1))

all_wnn_umap_by_subj -> figure_s7b

all_wnn_umap_by_subj
```
